name: act_vit_prefix_eval
_comment: Issue #149 eval-only arm. Identical model and hyperparameters to act_vit; run against an EXISTING full-length checkpoint (training is skipped when final_weights.pt is present) and scored at k=16/32/48/64. Truncation is a slice of the token axis — act_vit's adaptive max-pool absorbs the narrower width, so no retraining and no mask are involved. This is the deployability regime (train full, test on prefix), directly comparable to the contrastive layer_only control; it is NOT matched-k.
